## The founding documents, mapped

EOS is, on purpose, built like a government, so each piece below has a real-world analog you already understand. The legal envelope (Delaware corporate law and federal securities law) is the constitution EOS lives *under* and cannot rewrite. Everything here is what EOS writes inside that envelope.

| Function in a government | EOS document | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Declaration of Independence | [Declaration of Optimization](../strategy/declaration-of-optimization.qmd) | States the purpose of government (the two metrics) and the grievances |
| The Constitution | [Earth Optimization Protocol](../strategy/earth-optimization-protocol-v1.qmd) | Constitutes the institutions and the separation of powers |
| Bill of Rights + amendment rule | [Planetary Constitutional Convention](../strategy/planetary-constitutional-convention.qmd) | The inviolable constraints and how a revision is proposed and ratified |
| Ratification | [Global Referendum](../strategy/global-referendum.qmd) | How humanity signs |
| The legislature (power of the purse) | [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) | Aggregates what humans want and allocates the budget |
| The evidence and audit branch | [Optimocracy](../solution/optimocracy.qmd) | Checks which policies actually work |
| The judiciary | [Court of Humanity](../solution/court-of-humanity.qmd) | Adjudicates and enforces |
| The executive and treasury | [EOS](../solution/earth-optimization-services.qmd) + [DIH](../solution/dih.qmd) | Operates the company and disburses the funds |

The terminal objective every layer serves is one statement: **maximize the median number of healthy life years and the median after-tax, inflation-adjusted income of humanity.** Any departure from the approach best supported by the evidence has to justify itself with evidence.

## Two votes, never one

Money can buy economic exposure to EOS. Money can never buy the civic vote (one per human, non-transferable) or Wishocracy allocation power. The two sit at separate tables by design. See [EOS](../solution/earth-optimization-services.qmd) for the corporate side and [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) for the civic side.
